name: cards-demo-2
blurb: Blog-style author card with image, title, and author info.
description: Demo card designed as a blog post or article card. Displays author image/avatar, title, and author byline. CardDemo component wrapper with semantic article styling.
use_when: Blog listings, article previews, or author spotlight sections.
avoid_when: When you need interactive features beyond static display.
a11y: Author info and title are text content. Images have alt text. Semantic structure depends on implementation.
